heapUsedDeltaMeaning: Profiler.GetMonoUsedSizeLong difference is only corroborating evidence that the 1 MiB buffer existed. It is not an allocation counter and is not substituted for allocation measurements.
disclosure: This Unity Editor returns zero even after an intentionally retained 1 MiB allocation. Allocation counter results are unavailable, not zero. All profiler allocation metrics are suppressed when unavailable. Idle functional tests still assert disabled scheduling, stable meshes/colliders/revisions and no rebuilds; they cannot prove zero managed allocation on this Editor. CPU durations and separately labelled mesh-memory measurements remain valid.
